exposure: insulin aspart injection plus high-dose vitamin D supplementation
insulin aspart injection plus low-dose vitamin D supplementation
cohort: 129 gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) patients admitted to Zhongshan Hospital Xiamen University between December 2021 and December 2023.
finding: Insulin aspart injection plus high-dose vitamin D supplementation significantly improved treatment efficacy, glycemic control, and maternal and infant outcomes in GDM patients compared to low-dose vitamin D supplementation.
mod_finding: The high-dose vitamin D supplementation group showed better maternal outcomes, including a lower rate of cesarean section.
